neighbours.label: The 'range' family of tokens: ' range', ' Range', ' ranging', ' ranger', 'angel' in rangeland, 'ef' in rangefinder; words of similar shape stay quiet.
fire: Cattle graze on open rangeland in the west.
A park ranger showed us the trail.
The mountain range runs north to south.
Sizes ranging from small to large are in stock.
Her new Range Rover broke down.
A laser rangefinder sits on the rifle.
Ranchers fenced the rangelands last spring.
Temperatures ranging up to ninety are normal.
quiet: Cattle graze on open pasture in the west.
A park angel statue marks the trail.
The mountain ranch sits north of town.
Sizes going from small to large are in stock.
Her new Land Rover broke down.
A laser pointer sits on the rifle.
Ranchers fenced the orange groves last spring.
Temperatures rising up to ninety are normal.

notes: Probes: 0.30-0.92. ' rank' 0.00, 'radio' 0.01, 'Rage' 0.16. The output direction promotes ' ranges', ' bounds'. Peak tokens include pieces that follow an 'r' or ' r', so the first letter is a separate token in rangeland and Ranger.
